title: Wildheart wears a witchy purple, and the Sites editor tints with it

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-26: no old violet from the style system; Wildheart gets a witchy purple accent

detail: Wildheart's own accent set moves to a richer purple (violet #6A3FA0, pressed #55308A, text #5F3694, top #7A52AE) in lib/theme/wildheart.ts and the editor theme contract; vellum on violet 6.94:1, link text 7.46:1 on parchment. The Sites editor's selection ring, hover ring and soft washes wear --ed-accent (the theme accent) while a Wildheart site is open; the pastel buttons keep their ink label. The old #5B3FD0 violet is not used. The editor theme test pin follows the palette value.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const w=fs.readFileSync('lib/theme/wildheart.ts','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('components/sites/editor/editor.css','utf8');const bad=[];if(!w.includes(\"violet: '#6A3FA0'\"))bad.push('Wildheart violet moved');if(/5B3FD0/i.test(w))bad.push('old violet is back');if(!/data-website-theme=\"Wildheart\"\] \.we-shell/.test(c))bad.push('editor lost the Wildheart tint');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1363: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when Wildheart's purple reverts, the old violet returns, or the editor stops tinting with the theme accent.
